title: Eh, So What?
summary: If you ever doubted this market’s ability to shrug off inconvenient news, today’s activity should put that notion to rest. While there have been suspicions about Nvidia’s (NVDA) CEO, Jensen Huang, having an affair with a female executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed for some time, they were confirmed in a statement by the company yesterday afternoon. The fact that Mr. Huang had an extramarital affair is something he’ll need to explain to his wife; we all need an explanation about the company’s acknowledgement that “...CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort.”
